component.name: steamlite
component.summary: Lightweight launcher for installed Steam games

description.p: steamlite shows your installed Steam games as a fast, keyboard-driven grid of covers and launches them through the Steam client running hidden in the background, so you never have to open Steam's heavy UI.
It reads Steam's library files read-only, uses the local cover cache, and ships three themes (midnight, paper and a retro CDE look) that you can override with your own CSS.
